result.rationale: NSAID use at 26 weeks (4 days, 1200 mg/day) warrants prompt clinician review of fetal risk (oligohydramnios, ductal effects) and possible follow-up, but patient is asymptomatic with normal fetal movements, so no same-day emergency red flags. Advise stopping ibuprofen and using acetaminophen if needed; seek urgent care if decreased fetal movement, bleeding, leaking fluid, or contractions.
